claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.weapon
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Shillelagh attaches to a held Club or Quarterstaff, not to the caster generally and not to an arbitrary target.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "A Club or Quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.modify_roll_substitute
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell substitutes spellcasting ability for Strength on both attack and damage rolls with the bound weapon. The current surface only supports numeric roll modifiers or bonus damage riders.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of melee attacks using that weapon"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: weapon_attack_override
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell rewrites the weapon's damage expression and damage-type choice, including cantrip scaling and weapon-bound early-end conditions. The current ongoing-effect shape has no way to express a bound weapon attack profile plus recast/drop break clauses.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "the weapon's damage die becomes a d8"; "it can be Force damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice)"; "The spell ends early if you cast it again or if you let go of the weapon."
